amdahl_declaration.arithmetic_class: no candidate; future acceptance/commit changes exact control and state ownership
amdahl_declaration.scope: four-category B2/tg8 host acceptance plus draft cursor repair
amdahl_declaration.mechanism: admission audit for device first-mismatch, acceptance, commit, rollback, and cursor repair
amdahl_declaration.strict_fallback: host acceptance plus serial target.step and draft.trim
overlap_exclusions: acceptance_control and draft_commit_or_rollback are exclusive host buckets
target verification and proposal wall are excluded
device transaction and mismatch replay belong to the blocked verifier, not this owner

decision.reason: Deleting the measured host owner saves at most 0.020% of four-category wall, while the prerequisite verifier route adds 3.331 seconds on the ten-prompt suite. Acceptance kernels cannot repair verifier economics and would optimize the wrong Amdahl owner.
decision.unblock: First produce an exact operation-complete target-body verifier that beats serial MTP on complete wall. Re-profile acceptance after that route changes ownership.
